transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because people keep treating this foreclosure like it’s just paperwork or missed payments, but that’s not what’s happening. I know the bank, the loan servicer, and even people at my job have been quietly working together to push me out of my house. They can show me whatever papers they want, but I’ve been seeing this going on for almost two years.
Do you feel like people are specifically targeting you?

Yes. I feel like they’re targeting me specifically. The bank and the loan servicer, and even some people at my job, they’ve been working together quietly to get me out of my house. Everyone keeps saying it’s just paperwork or missed payments, but I know what I’ve been seeing, and it’s been going on for almost two years.
Do you think these people are trying to harm you in any way beyond just taking your house?

I don’t know that they’re trying to hurt me physically. What I know is they’re trying to push me out of my house. The bank, the loan servicer, and people at my job are all connected in this, and everyone keeps acting like it’s just paperwork or missed payments, but I’ve been seeing it for almost two years. Papers don’t change that.
Have you ever had a period of time where you didn't think the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job were working together against you?
Before that started, no, I didn’t think that. But since the foreclosure notices and the bank calls began taking over our home life, it’s been constant. That’s been about a year and nine months now.
Do you still believe the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job are working together against you?

Yes, I still believe it. That’s why I’m here. Everyone keeps trying to make it sound like it’s just foreclosure paperwork or missed payments, but I know what I’ve been seeing. The bank, the loan servicer, and people at my job have been quietly working together to push me out of my house. Showing me more papers doesn’t change that.
For how long have you believed the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job are working together against you?
About a year and nine months. It started around when the foreclosure notices and the bank calls really began taking over things at home, and it’s been going on since then.
Have you ever had a period of at least a month where you didn't think the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job were working together against you?

No. Not since it started. It’s been about a year and nine months, since the foreclosure notices and bank calls started taking over at home, and I haven’t had a month where I didn’t think they were working together.
Do you have any other thoughts that you think are true, but others might not believe?

I mean, it’s mainly this same thing. I know other people don’t believe me, or they act like I’m reading too much into it, but I believe the bank, the loan servicer, and even people at my job are connected in this. They’re trying to push me out of my house, and everyone keeps saying it’s just paperwork or missed payments, but that’s not what I’m seeing. Showing me more papers doesn’t change it.
Do you have any other thoughts that you think are true, but others might not believe, besides the one about the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job working together against you?
No, not really. I can’t think of anything separate from that. It’s all tied to the bank and the house situation.
Have your beliefs about the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job working together against you lasted for at least one month without changing?

Yes. It hasn’t really changed. It’s been going on about a year and nine months now, since the foreclosure notices and the bank calls started taking over our home life. I’ve thought they were working together that whole time.
Do you think there's any possibility that you might be mistaken about the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job working together against you?

No. I mean, people keep telling me it could just be paperwork or missed payments, but that doesn’t fit what I’ve been seeing. The bank, the loan servicer, and people at my job are connected in this, and they’ve been trying to push me out of my house. Showing me more papers doesn’t change that for me.
Have you experienced any other situations in your life where you felt like things were happening in a way that others didn't understand or believe?

Not really outside of this. It’s mainly this foreclosure situation. Everyone keeps saying it’s just paperwork or missed payments, but I know the bank, the loan servicer, and even some people at my job have been quietly working together to push me out of my house. They can show me all the papers they want, but that doesn’t change what I’ve been seeing for almost two years.
Has your belief that the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job are working together against you affected your ability to work or take care of daily responsibilities?

Yes, it has. I’m still working and I still handle what I need to, but it’s made things harder. At home, my marriage has gotten more tense because any talk about the foreclosure turns into an argument. And at work, I’ve had a few tense exchanges with managers over regular paperwork. I can tell people are more careful around me now.
Has your belief that the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job are working together against you caused problems in your relationships with friends or family members beyond your marriage?

Mostly it’s been my marriage. I don’t know that it’s caused big problems with friends or other family, not like that. But at home, the foreclosure stuff keeps turning into arguments, and that’s made things tense. And at work I’ve had some tense exchanges with managers over paperwork, so people seem more careful around me now. I’m still working, but it’s affected things.
Have you ever had a period of less than a month where you didn't believe the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job were working together against you?

No, not really. It’s been steady since it started — about a year and nine months now, since the foreclosure notices and the bank calls started taking over things at home. I haven’t had a stretch where I just didn’t believe it was happening.
Have you ever had a period where you didn't believe the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job were working together against you that lasted less than a month?

No, I don’t think so. Like I said, it’s been going on for about a year and nine months now, since the foreclosure notices and the bank calls started taking over things at home. I haven’t really had a break from believing it.
Have you ever had any other beliefs that you held strongly, but others did not believe or thought were strange?

Not really other things, no. It’s mostly this situation with the foreclosure. People keep saying it’s just paperwork or missed payments, but I know the bank, the loan servicer, and even people at my job have been working together to push me out of my house. I’ve been seeing it for almost two years, and the papers they show me don’t change that.
Do you think your belief about the bank, loan servicer, and people at your job working together against you could be proven wrong with evidence?

No. I mean, they keep showing me papers and saying it’s just missed payments or foreclosure paperwork, but that doesn’t prove anything to me. I know what I’ve been seeing — the bank, the loan servicer, and people at my job have been working together to push me out of my house. Papers don’t change that.
Have you ever felt like other people or groups, outside of those involved in the foreclosure, are out to get you or harm you in some way?

No, not really outside of that. It’s the bank, the loan servicer, and some people at my job. That’s where it’s been coming from. Everyone keeps acting like it’s just foreclosure paperwork or missed payments, but I know they’ve been working together to push me out of my house.
